system/io.k3sm.netd = {
	active count = 1
	path = /Library/LaunchDaemons/io.k3sm.netd.plist
	state = running
	program = /Library/k3sm/k3sm

	arguments = {
		/Library/k3sm/k3sm
		netd
		--socket
		/var/lib/k3sm/run/netd.sock
	}

	stdout path = /var/log/k3sm/netd.log
	stderr path = /var/log/k3sm/netd.log
	pid = 1292
	immediate reason = speculative
	forks = 0
	execs = 1
	runs = 1
	last exit code = (never exited)
}
